"""解析 .lnk 快捷方式指向的真实路径"""
import struct
import os

def parse_lnk(filepath):
    """解析 Windows .lnk 快捷方式文件，提取目标路径"""
    with open(filepath, 'rb') as f:
        data = f.read()
    
    print(f"文件大小: {len(data)} 字节")
    
    # LNK 文件头
    if data[:4] != b'\x4c\x00\x00\x00':
        print("不是有效的 LNK 文件")
        return None
    
    # Flags (offset 0x14, 4 bytes)
    flags = struct.unpack('<I', data[0x14:0x18])[0]
    print(f"Flags: 0x{flags:08X}")
    
    has_link_target = bool(flags & 0x01)
    has_link_info = bool(flags & 0x02)
    has_name = bool(flags & 0x04)
    has_rel_path = bool(flags & 0x08)
    has_working_dir = bool(flags & 0x10)
    has_arguments = bool(flags & 0x20)
    has_icon_location = bool(flags & 0x40)
    
    print(f"  has_link_target: {has_link_target}")
    print(f"  has_link_info: {has_link_info}")
    print(f"  has_name: {has_name}")
    print(f"  has_rel_path: {has_rel_path}")
    print(f"  has_working_dir: {has_working_dir}")
    print(f"  has_arguments: {has_arguments}")
    print(f"  has_icon_location: {has_icon_location}")
    
    # 提取所有 Unicode 字符串（每两个字节一个字符，以 \x00\x00 结尾）
    print("\n--- 提取所有 Unicode 字符串 ---")
    i = 0
    strings_found = []
    while i < len(data) - 1:
        # 尝试提取 Unicode 字符串
        if data[i] >= 0x20 and data[i] < 0x7f:
            # 可能是 ASCII 字符的开始
            char_start = i
            s = b''
            while i < len(data) - 1:
                ch = data[i]
                null = data[i+1]
                if null == 0 and ch >= 0x20 and ch < 0x7f:
                    s += bytes([ch])
                    i += 2
                else:
                    break
            if len(s) >= 3:
                text = s.decode('ascii', errors='ignore')
                strings_found.append((char_start, text))
        i += 1
    
    for offset, text in strings_found:
        print(f"  [offset 0x{offset:04X}] {text}")
    
    # 尝试提取 UTF-16LE 中文字符串
    print("\n--- 提取 UTF-16LE 字符串 (含中文) ---")
    try:
        # 尝试把整个文件作为 UTF-16LE 解码，找到可读部分
        text = data.decode('utf-16-le', errors='ignore')
        # 过滤出有意义的片段
        import re
        # 找出中英文字符串片段
        segments = re.findall(r'[\u4e00-\u9fff\u0020-\u007e]{3,}', text)
        for seg in segments:
            print(f"  {seg}")
    except:
        pass
    
    return strings_found

"""用 Python 解析 .lnk 快捷方式的目标路径"""
import struct
import os

def parse_lnk_target(filepath):
    with open(filepath, 'rb') as f:
        data = f.read()
    
    # LNK Header is 76 bytes
    # After header, we have Shell Item ID List (if flag bit 0 set)
    flags = struct.unpack('<I', data[0x14:0x18])[0]
    
    offset = 0x4C  # Header size
    
    # Skip Shell Item ID List if present
    if flags & 0x01:
        id_list_size = struct.unpack('<H', data[offset:offset+2])[0]
        offset += 2 + id_list_size
    
    # Link Info
    if flags & 0x02:
        link_info_size = struct.unpack('<I', data[offset:offset+4])[0]
        link_info_start = offset
        
        # LinkInfoFlags
        li_flags = struct.unpack('<I', data[offset+4:offset+8])[0]
        
        # VolumeIDOffset
        vol_id_offset = struct.unpack('<I', data[offset+8:offset+12])[0]
        
        # LocalBasePathOffset
        local_base_path_offset = struct.unpack('<I', data[offset+12:offset+16])[0]
        
        # CommonNetworkRelativeLinkOffset
        cnrl_offset = struct.unpack('<I', data[offset+16:offset+20])[0]
        
        # CommonPathSuffixOffset
        cps_offset = struct.unpack('<I', data[offset+20:offset+24])[0]
        
        print(f"LinkInfoFlags: 0x{li_flags:08X}")
        print(f"  LocalBasePathOffset: {local_base_path_offset}")
        print(f"  CommonPathSuffixOffset: {cps_offset}")
        
        # LocalBasePath
        if li_flags & 0x01:
            bp_start = link_info_start + local_base_path_offset
            # Read null-terminated ASCII string
            bp_end = data.index(b'\x00', bp_start)
            local_base_path = data[bp_start:bp_end].decode('ascii', errors='replace')
            print(f"  LocalBasePath: {local_base_path}")
        
        # CommonPathSuffix
        cps_start = link_info_start + cps_offset
        cps_end = data.index(b'\x00', cps_start)
        common_path_suffix = data[cps_start:cps_end].decode('ascii', errors='replace')
        print(f"  CommonPathSuffix: {common_path_suffix}")
        
        offset += link_info_size
    
    # String Data
    # Name (description)
    if flags & 0x04:
        char_count = struct.unpack('<H', data[offset:offset+2])[0]
        offset += 2
        if flags & 0x80:  # Unicode
            name = data[offset:offset+char_count*2].decode('utf-16-le', errors='replace')
            offset += char_count * 2
        else:
            name = data[offset:offset+char_count].decode('ascii', errors='replace')
            offset += char_count
        print(f"Name: {name}")
    
    # Relative Path
    if flags & 0x08:
        char_count = struct.unpack('<H', data[offset:offset+2])[0]
        offset += 2
        if flags & 0x80:  # Unicode
            rel_path = data[offset:offset+char_count*2].decode('utf-16-le', errors='replace')
            offset += char_count * 2
        else:
            rel_path = data[offset:offset+char_count].decode('ascii', errors='replace')
            offset += char_count
        print(f"RelativePath: {rel_path}")
    
    # Working Directory
    if flags & 0x10:
        char_count = struct.unpack('<H', data[offset:offset+2])[0]
        offset += 2
        if flags & 0x80:  # Unicode
            work_dir = data[offset:offset+char_count*2].decode('utf-16-le', errors='replace')
            offset += char_count * 2
        else:
            work_dir = data[offset:offset+char_count].decode('ascii', errors='replace')
            offset += char_count
        print(f"WorkingDirectory: {work_dir}")
    
    # Arguments
    if flags & 0x20:
        char_count = struct.unpack('<H', data[offset:offset+2])[0]
        offset += 2
        if flags & 0x80:  # Unicode
            args = data[offset:offset+char_count*2].decode('utf-16-le', errors='replace')
            offset += char_count * 2
        else:
            args = data[offset:offset+char_count].decode('ascii', errors='replace')
            offset += char_count
        print(f"Arguments: {args}")
    
    # Icon Location
    if flags & 0x40:
        char_count = struct.unpack('<H', data[offset:offset+2])[0]
        offset += 2
        if flags & 0x80:  # Unicode
            icon_loc = data[offset:offset+char_count*2].decode('utf-16-le', errors='replace')
            offset += char_count * 2
        else:
            icon_loc = data[offset:offset+char_count].decode('ascii', errors='replace')
            offset += char_count
        print(f"IconLocation: {icon_loc}")
